partner.title: Demo partner page
partner.body: In production, this click would take you to the seller's website, where you would review the fare rules and complete your booking and payment with them. Because this is a demo, no partner site is opened and nothing is booked.
partner.recorded: Your click was recorded anonymously so we can measure how the comparison service is used.

about.title: About us
about.intro: {site} is a travel search and comparison service operated from Quebec, Canada. We help travellers compare flight offers from authorised travel partners and then send them to the seller to book.
about.what: We search partner inventory, show offers side by side, and link you to the airline or agency that sells the ticket.
about.not: We are not an airline or a travel agency. We do not sell tickets, take payments, issue tickets or manage bookings.
about.money: Some partners may pay us a commission when a booking is made after you follow our link. This never changes the price you pay. Read our affiliate disclosure for details.

contact.title: Contact
contact.intro: Questions about our website, your privacy, or a partnership? Get in touch.
contact.booking: Bookings, payments, tickets, changes, refunds and cancellations are handled by the seller you booked with (the airline or travel agency). Please contact them directly; their details are in your confirmation email.
contact.responseTime: We aim to reply within 5 business days.

legal.draftBanner: DRAFT: This text is a working draft prepared for review by a qualified lawyer. It is not legal advice and has not been approved.

footer.disclosure: We may earn a commission from partners when you book through our links, at no extra cost to you.
footer.about: Flight comparison and referrals. We don't sell tickets.

consent.title: Your choice of cookies
consent.body: We'd like to load content from our travel partners through Travelpayouts (live Kiwi.com fares, Klook activities, AirHelp compensation checks, helpful travel links). These partners may set cookies so bookings can be credited to us. Nothing loads unless you allow it, and you can change your mind at any time under “Cookie settings”.
